envelopeMessage: You notice a piece of parchment left behind as you arrive home.

defaults.premise: "Every stolen conversation we've shared lately has only left me wishing we didn't have to hide in the shadows."
defaults.clue: "Meet me near {location} when you can slip away cleanly."
defaults.signOff: (The bottom corner of the parchment and the sender's signature have been hastily burned away in the hearth embers.)

Romantic.salutation: "Dearest {partner}, I cannot stop thinking about our last quiet talk..."

Humble.salutation: "Dear {partner}, I know how hesitant you have been, and I promise no one will learn of our meetings..."

Independent.salutation: "{partner}, slip away from the house whenever you have a spare hour..."

Proud.salutation: "To the incomparable {partner}—someone of your grace deserves far more devotion than an empty hearth..."

Jealous.salutation: "{partner}, why wait at home alone while your partner wanders Skyrim? Let us talk again tonight..."
